entries.sense_en: a church worker who rings the bell and looks after the church and graveyard

synonyms.nuance: Church official who assists during services; more ceremonial, less about graves or bells.
synonyms.example: the verger led the choir in

synonyms.nuance: General word for someone who looks after any building; not specifically religious.
Only the burial work; a sexton often did this as one of several jobs.

entries.sense_en: neat, trim and smartly dressed

synonyms.nuance: Stylish and neat, often of a small man; slightly more charming.
synonyms.example: a dapper little man in a bow tie

synonyms.nuance: Most general British/everyday word for well-dressed; less vivid.
Informal; fashionably neat, a bit showy.

entries.tip_ko: '가문비나무'라는 명사 spruce와 형태는 같지만 여기서는 형용사입니다.

entries.sense_en: a large crowd of people pressed together

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; any large group, no sense of pressing together.
Formal/literary; a very great number, often with a solemn tone.
Negative; a disorderly, possibly violent crowd.

entries.sense_en: to ring a large bell slowly and repeatedly

synonyms.nuance: General: make any bell sound, quickly or slowly.
Ring loudly, usually many bells, often joyfully.
synonyms.example: the bells pealed at the wedding

synonyms.nuance: Softer, musical sound, often marking the hour.

entries.tip_ko: toll은 '통행료'라는 뜻도 있지만 여기서는 종을 울리는 동사입니다.

entries.sense_en: an outward appearance or likeness of someone

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; how something looks, with no hint that it may be false.
A close resemblance to another person or thing.
synonyms.example: a good likeness of her mother

synonyms.nuance: An outward form that hides the real nature.
synonyms.example: in the guise of a beggar

entries.sense_en: without any doubt

synonyms.nuance: Everyday form of the old phrase.
Formal; there is no doubt at all.
Informal, spoken.

entries.sense_en: wrapped or bound around with cloth

synonyms.nuance: Everyday, general; any covering, not necessarily many layers.
Cover completely so as to hide; often gloomy or mysterious.
Medical: bind a wound.

entries.sense_en: thin black cloth worn or hung as a sign of mourning

synonyms.nuance: Modern spelling; the fabric in general, not only black or mourning.
A thin, see-through cloth, often for medical use.
The covering itself; may be any fabric, worn on the face.

entries.sense_en: to block or stop something on its way

synonyms.nuance: General; stop anything, not only something in motion.
Informal; stop the path or supply.
Formal; put an obstacle in the way, often for longer.

entries.sense_en: lost in thought and not noticing what is around

synonyms.nuance: Forgetful or inattentive as a habit, not just at the moment.
Busy thinking about one worry or matter.
Attention pulled away by something, often unwillingly.

entries.sense_en: to walk with difficulty and short, uneven steps

synonyms.nuance: Walk unevenly because of an injured leg or foot; the standard word.
Drag the feet without lifting them; slow but not always painful.
Walk unsteadily as if about to fall.

entries.sense_en: impossible to explain
entries.sense_ko: 설명할 수 없는, 까닭을 알 수 없는

synonyms.nuance: More formal; cannot be explained at all.
Suggests something strange and secret, not just unexplained.
Confusing; emphasizes the puzzled feeling.

entries.sense_en: in a state of excited movement

synonyms.nuance: Being in motion; less about excitement.
Informal; full of noisy excited talk.
Upset and restless; more negative.

entries.sense_en: in conflict with; not matching

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; in disagreement or conflict.
Formal; facts or statements that do not fit.
Directly opposed to.

entries.sense_en: anxious disturbance of mind

synonyms.nuance: Strong restless feeling, visible in movement.
Quiet unease; milder.
A noisy disturbance among many people.

entries.sense_en: deserving deep respect because of great age

synonyms.nuance: Deeply respected by many; age is not required.
Neutral word for old people; no respect implied.
Respected for achievement, not age.

entries.sense_en: the face, especially its expression

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday word; no focus on expression.
The look on a face, not the face itself.
More literary still; the face as it strikes the viewer, often stern or pale.

entries.sense_en: a person's natural character and way of reacting

synonyms.nuance: Usual mood or tendency; nearly interchangeable but more formal.
Broader; basic character of a person or thing.
Usually means anger, not general character.

entries.sense_en: gladly; willingly

synonyms.nuance: Everyday equivalent of the old word.
Emphasizes no reluctance.
Stronger; shows keen wish.

entries.modern: would fain → would gladly / would like to

entries.sense_en: the One who knows everything; God

synonyms.nuance: Names God by his power, not his knowledge; the commonest such title.
Names God as maker of the world; used later in this story.
Names God as one who sees everything; close, but about sight rather than knowledge.
synonyms.example: nothing is hidden from the All-seeing

entries.tip_ko: 보통은 형용사(전지한)이지만 여기서는 the + 대문자로 '전지하신 분'이라는 명사로 쓰였습니다. omni-는 '모든', -scient는 '아는'이라는 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: wicked or sinful behavior

synonyms.nuance: Religious; breaking God's law.
General evil character or acts.
Unfair treatment rather than moral evil.

entries.sense_en: a quality that makes people feel pity or sadness

synonyms.nuance: Sadness that is sharp and touching.
The feeling itself, not the quality that causes it.
Everyday and plain; lacks the touching effect.

entries.tip_ko: 형용사 pathetic은 '한심한' 뜻이 강하지만 pathos는 진지하게 슬픈 감정입니다.

entries.sense_en: a person's face, seen as a whole

synonyms.nuance: Neutral everyday word.
Face with its expression; formal.
The separate parts of the face.

entries.sense_en: happening or existing together

synonyms.nuance: Plain word without the image of two partners.
Formal; working side by side.
Also literal: beside each other.

entries.sense_en: not polite or proper for the occasion

synonyms.nuance: General; wrong by rules or manners.
Not fitting for the situation, often a solemn one.
Openly impolite, more direct and intentional.

entries.sense_en: done to show off and get attention

synonyms.nuance: Bright and attention-getting; less critical.
Informal; cheap or loud display.
Claiming more importance or culture than one has.

entries.sense_en: wise and shrewd in judging (said with irony here: looking knowing)

synonyms.nuance: General; deep knowledge and judgment.
Sharp in practical matters, may be cunning.
Quick to see how to gain advantage.

entries.tip_ko: 수수께끼를 꿰뚫어 본 척 고개를 젓는 사람들을 작가가 비꼬아 쓴 말입니다.

entries.sense_en: white or grey with age

synonyms.nuance: Plain description of hair color.
Ordinary color word; not necessarily old.
Very old, not about hair.

entries.sense_en: in the habit of doing something

synonyms.nuance: Used to something through experience.
Everyday form: used to do.
Tending to; likely rather than habitual.

entries.modern: was wont to bless → used to bless

entries.sense_en: held in and not expressed

synonyms.nuance: Deliberately pushed down; often psychological.
Informal; feelings kept inside.
Forced to stop or hide.

entries.sense_en: wrong; not as it should be

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and general.
Off course; plans going badly.
Not working or not proper.
synonyms.example: the lift is out of order

entries.tip_ko: 'take it amiss(기분 나빠하다)' 표현도 함께 기억하세요.

entries.sense_en: a strange, unpredictable idea or action

synonyms.nuance: A sudden wish without reason.
Formal and literary; unpredictable change of mind.
A harmless odd habit.

entries.sense_en: to hesitate because it seems morally wrong

synonyms.nuance: General; pause before acting for any reason.
Refuse suddenly to continue.
Formal; raise a polite objection.

entries.modern: scrupled not to affirm → did not hesitate to say

entries.sense_en: something amazing or unnatural, seen as a sign

synonyms.nuance: Something amazing; positive.
Something that causes admiring surprise; nothing unnatural or ominous.
A sign of the future; that sense is close here.

entries.sense_en: to be a sign that something bad will happen

synonyms.nuance: Hint at a future event, especially in stories.
Used with well/ill; a general sign.
Say what will happen; a claim, not a sign.

entries.sense_en: the slow sound of a bell rung for a death or funeral

synonyms.nuance: The ringing itself; can be any slow bell.
Loud, often happy ringing.
Light musical sound.

entries.sense_en: frightening

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for the same act.
Much stronger fear.
Sudden, brief shock.

entries.sense_en: playful joking or a prank

synonyms.nuance: A trick played on someone.
Naughty behavior, may cause trouble.
Quaint humor.

entries.sense_en: almost

synonyms.nuance: Everyday equivalent.
Neutral; close to something.
Practically, in effect.

entries.sense_en: a nosy person who meddles in others' affairs

synonyms.nuance: British informal; playful.
Stresses actual interference.
Someone who spreads talk.

entries.sense_en: earnest words of protest meant to make someone change what they are doing

synonyms.nuance: Broader; may be public and loud.
Stating disagreement, less pressure.
Criticism showing disappointment.

entries.sense_en: suitable and practical in the circumstances; the advisable thing to do

synonyms.nuance: Wise to do; the closest plain word here, without any hint of self-interest.
Easy or suitable for you; about comfort, not about what serves the purpose.
Works in real life; neutral, with no idea of choosing advantage over principle.

entries.tip_ko: expedite(신속히 처리하다) 때문에 '빠른'으로 오해하기 쉽지만 '형편에 알맞은'이라는 뜻입니다. 요즘은 '원칙보다 편의를 앞세운'이라는 부정적 어감으로 자주 쓰입니다.

entries.sense_en: embarrassed and ashamed

synonyms.nuance: General word for feeling awkward.
Guilt about a wrong deed.
Slightly embarrassed after a small mistake.

entries.sense_en: a group sent to speak for others

synonyms.nuance: Common word; nearly identical.
A group with continuing duties.
One representative, usually to another country.

entries.sense_en: promised in marriage

synonyms.nuance: Formal or old; engaged to marry.
Everyday modern word.
Broader, not only marriage.

entries.tip_ko: plight의 흔한 뜻 '곤경'과 다른 옛 뜻('맹세하다')입니다.

entries.sense_en: stubborn refusal to change

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word.
Positive; firm purpose.
Informal and insulting.

entries.sense_en: an earnest, pleading request

synonyms.nuance: Emotional, urgent request.
Request for help, often public.
Neutral; no begging.

entries.sense_en: a person or thing that causes great, often needless, fear; a bogey

synonyms.nuance: Imaginary monster used to frighten children; the closest modern word here.
Someone or something that causes real, strong fear; not imaginary or needless.
Minor personal annoyance; close to today's weak sense of bugbear, not to this one.
synonyms.example: my pet peeve is loud chewing

entries.tip_ko: 요즘은 주로 '늘 거슬리는 골칫거리'라는 약한 뜻으로 쓰지만, 여기서는 원래 뜻인 '무서운 존재'입니다.

entries.sense_en: beyond what is normal in nature; strange

synonyms.nuance: Beyond nature, involving ghosts or gods.
Strange and slightly frightening.
Not normal; may be merely artificial.

entries.sense_en: a strong feeling of dislike

synonyms.nuance: Wish to avoid something.
Active unfriendliness.
Mild, general word.

entries.sense_en: the quality of seeming believable

synonyms.nuance: Trustworthiness of a source or claim.
Plain everyday equivalent.
How probable, not how convincing.

entries.sense_en: to spread from person to person

synonyms.nuance: General word.
Move around among many people.
Modern usual form of the idiom.

entries.modern: go the rounds → make the rounds

entries.sense_en: to avoid and keep away from on purpose

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; simply keep away, with no sense of rejecting the person.
Formal; exclude from a group.
Ignore rudely in a single moment.

entries.sense_en: to make pain or trouble less severe

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; make less painful.
Formal; reduce suffering.
Take away pain fully or partly.

entries.sense_en: a state of inactivity, as if half asleep

synonyms.nuance: Lack of energy, often from illness or boredom.
Near unconsciousness, dazed.
Not caring; mental rather than physical.

entries.sense_en: anxious care that something should not happen

synonyms.nuance: Worry mixed with fear; the closest plain word here, but without the idea of watchful care.
Everyday; may be mild, and usually felt for another person.
Broader; attention or worry of any strength.

entries.tip_ko: 요즘은 주로 '남을 위한 자상한 배려'를 뜻하지만, 여기서는 베일이 벗겨질까 봐 애태우는 마음입니다.

entries.sense_en: filled with shock and horror

synonyms.nuance: Strong disgust and fear.
Shocked by something wrong.
Milder, general.

entries.sense_en: in a way that is deeply disgusting

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; often just a casual intensifier.
Showing hate toward others, rather than causing disgust in them.
Causes physical revulsion.

entries.sense_en: slowly decayed and turned to dust

synonyms.nuance: General rotting.
Informal, smellier.
Break into small pieces.
